report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that their mutual fund portfolio values and P&L were unchanged from the previous day, while stock holdings updated normally. Investigation revealed that the scheduled nightly mutual fund NAV import (nav-import) at 2026-10-13 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) failed when market-data-service encountered an unhandled string value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 at line 8982 of AMFI's NAVAll.txt file. The parser threw an unhandled error and aborted the entire import batch, writing 0 of 14,231 NAV records. As a result, market-data-service served stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12, causing portfolio-service to fall back to the prior day's mutual fund valuations.
report.rootCauseStatement: The nightly mutual fund NAV ingestion job in market-data-service aborted completely after encountering an unhandled 'N.A.' string value for scheme code 118191 on line 8982 of AMFI's NAVAll.txt file. This caused 0 out of 14,231 NAV records to be written and left the previous trading day's NAVs (2026-10-12) active, resulting in stale mutual fund valuations across user portfolios.

hypotheses.cause: The nightly mutual fund NAV import pipeline in market-data-service failed to handle an 'N.A.' NAV entry on line 8982 (scheme code 118191) in the downloaded AMFI feed file, aborting with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written and leaving previous NAVs from 2026-10-12 active.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct log evidence confirms that job-scheduler dispatched nav-import at 18:00 UTC on 2026-10-13, and market-data-service aborted at 18:02 UTC with an explicit parse error ('invalid NAV value N.A. for scheme code 118191') resulting in 0 of 14,231 records written. Metrics confirm nav_age_s steadily aged past 34 hours without resetting, and portfolio-service logged warnings using 2026-10-12 NAVs.

hypotheses.cause: The external AMFI NAV feed published an invalid or corrupted data entry ('N.A.' for scheme code 118191) in NAVAll.txt, violating format expectations and breaking downstream ingestion.
hypotheses.rationale: The feed did contain the literal string 'N.A.' instead of a float; however, external industry feeds commonly emit 'N.A.' for suspended or non-computed schemes, and an internal ingestion pipeline should not fail an entire batch due to a single invalid record.

hypotheses.cause: The deployment of portfolio-service v7.3.0 at 09:10 IST (03:40 UTC) introduced a valuation regression or caching bug causing stale valuations.
hypotheses.rationale: Although deployment CHG-48221 coincided with user complaints at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST), portfolio-service logs confirm identical stale NAV warnings ('nav_date=2026-10-12') running on v7.2.0 starting well before the deployment at 02:16 UTC. Furthermore, stock price age remained healthy at ~2 seconds.

facts.statement: job-scheduler triggered scheduled job nav-import (run_7fadae4b) at 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (23:30 IST), which failed at 18:06:00.000Z with exit code 1.

market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00.000Z, encountered a parse error at line 8982 ('invalid NAV value N.A. for scheme code 118191') at 18:02:00.000Z, and aborted the import writing 0 of 14,231 NAVs.
nav_age_s on market-data-service rose monotonically from ~82,740 seconds at 17:00 UTC on 2026-10-13 to ~125,460 seconds (~34.85 hours) by 04:55 UTC on 2026-10-14 without resetting.
portfolio-service logged 63 WARN messages starting at 02:16:24 UTC on 2026-10-14 stating that fund NAV was older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and fell back to the last available NAV.
portfolio-service price_age_s remained normal at ~2.01 seconds throughout the morning of 2026-10-14, and valuation_errors remained low at ~0.94/min.
portfolio-service was deployed with version 7.3.0 at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z under CHG-48221, while warnings regarding stale NAVs had already been logged on version 7.2.0 since 02:16:24 UTC.

inferences.statement: The failure of the nightly NAV import to commit any new records caused market-data-service to continue serving NAVs dated 2026-10-12, leading portfolio-service to evaluate fund holdings against stale data on 2026-10-14.

The portfolio-service deployment at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST) was a coincidental red herring; user complaints arose at 09:10 IST because users opened the application at market open rather than because of the v7.3.0 code release.

assumptions.statement: AMFI's NAVAll.txt feed format occasionally contains non-numeric strings such as 'N.A.' for suspended, merged, or non-active fund schemes, which ingestion parsers are expected to tolerate or skip.

market-data-service completes downloading NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed.
market-data-service encounters an invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191 at line 8982.
market-data-service aborts nav-import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving 2026-10-12 NAVs active.

confidence.rationale: Log messages and metrics from both job-scheduler and market-data-service directly capture the failure of nav-import, identifying the specific file, line number, scheme code, and invalid token. Metrics corroborate that NAVs were not updated and aged past 34 hours.

recommendedActions.action: Manually trigger a patched or filtered nav-import run in market-data-service that skips line 8982 or parses 'N.A.' as null to update current mutual fund NAVs immediately.
recommendedActions.rationale: Mutual fund NAVs are currently over 35 hours old; re-running the import will restore accurate current valuations and P&L for all users.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service metrics to verify nav_age_s resets to ~0 seconds, and verify that portfolio-service stops logging stale NAV warnings.

recommendedActions.action: Update the NAVAll.txt parsing logic in market-data-service to handle non-numeric NAV tokens such as 'N.A.' gracefully (by skipping or recording a null NAV) rather than aborting the entire file import.
recommendedActions.rationale: A single inactive, suspended, or unpriced scheme should not block ingestion of all other 14,000+ mutual fund NAVs.
recommendedActions.verification: Add unit and integration tests parsing mock AMFI feeds containing 'N.A.', empty values, and invalid floats, ensuring successful batch commit of valid records.

recommendedActions.action: Configure alerting on job-scheduler failure for nav-import and on market-data-service when nav_age_s exceeds 26 hours.
recommendedActions.rationale: The failure occurred at 23:36 IST on 2026-10-13 but was not noticed until users reported stale portfolios at 09:10 IST on 2026-10-14.
